description: This file defines a custom exception class `ProvisioningEntryNotfoundException` that extends `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException`, indicating that it is used to handle cases where a provisioning entry with a given ID is not found.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryNotfoundException
